titre: La dialyse à domicile a doublé de poids
sous_titre: Part des patients du régime public américain dialysant à domicile, en % par mois, 2011 à 2024

2011.texte: The share of FFS beneficiaries dialyzing at home steadily increased from 9 percent per month in 2011

2023.texte: steadily increased from 9 percent per month in 2011 (the first year of the ESRD PPS) to 17 percent per month in 2023

2024.texte: to 17 percent per month in 2023 and 18 percent per month in 2024
